assertions.name: no_error_kind_entries
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = every witness covers its enumerated scope)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every production witness has a complete row set for its declared atom / partition / block scope.

description: I13 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: every computations/*.witness.json is walked for `error_kind` fields anywhere in the JSON tree.  Each hit records the per-entry failure mode + sibling fields (which typically identify the failing atom/partition/label), giving a follow-up agent the per-entry queue needed to extend the upstream producer's coverage.
